assumptions.model: D_ij = delta + A_i + B_j + E_ij; independent zero-mean Gaussian random effects
assumptions.effect_sign: Positive paired absolute-loss difference means lower EEG-model loss
assumptions.scenario_provenance: Fixed analyst-chosen sensitivity assumptions; not empirical estimates
assumptions.gain_provenance: The root supplied 0.045 after published development summaries; scenarios are not blinded to public aggregates, but no empirical variance calibration is used
assumptions.units: Valence rating points in paired absolute-loss differences
assumptions.bootstrap_method: Independently resample both complete person and title axes with replacement; percentile quantiles 0.025/0.975
assumptions.translation_reuse: The same zero-gain matrix and bootstrap samples are translated by each fixed gain
limits: A Gaussian loss-difference approximation has unbounded support outside actual paired losses [-7,7]; it is not a rating generator or fitted EEG model
Simulation coverage/exclusion rates apply only to this synthetic random-effects model
Eight catalogue titles are an assigned roster, not a random representative sample of all films
Training/selection uncertainty, non-Gaussian errors, acquisition heterogeneity and missingness are omitted
The 0.15 gain is an engineering sensitivity value, not a clinically validated margin
The 66-person/16-title cases are hypothetical design comparisons, not permission to reassign protected roles
These calculations do not establish empirical power, promise significance or authorize confirmation access

metadata_dimensions.same_title_rule: Average paired losses within clips 7/8 before family-equal averaging

interpretation: Hypothetical precision sensitivity only; no empirical variance, power, effect or protected outcomes inferred
